lines.text: Paul tells the believers to submit to rulers and authorities, malign no one, and be peaceable and gentle.
God saved us not by our righteous deeds but according to His mercy, through the washing of new birth.
God poured out the Spirit through Jesus Christ, so that justified by grace we would become heirs with the hope of a promised land.
Paul says to avoid foolish controversies and to reject a divisive man after seven warnings, since he is self-condemned.
Paul asks Titus to come to him at Nicopolis for the winter and to equip Zenas the lawyer and Apollos.
